svg.aria-label: The plan-retro skill. Boxes: Each refuter report the previous retro did not list, read run by run (a step of the session); Each finding given one kind, each kind counted over steps and plans and quoted (a step of the session); The recurring kinds marked, a proposal drafted for each (a step of the session); The retro written from templates/retro.md and shown (a step of the session); The proposals (stop); Each decision written beside its proposal, the approved edits made (a step of the session); Each approved check's command run, its output shown (a step of the session); One commit of the retro and the edited files (a step of the session).
